description: Defines the MethodInfo class which models a method with parameters, including signature generation and type normalization.

classes.name: MethodInfo
classes.description: Container representing a method with parameters, capable of generating method signatures and normalizing parameter types.

methods.name: MethodInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes method name and return type, and prepares parameter list.

methods.name: getNameAndDescriptor
methods.description: Generates and returns the method's signature string, including parameter types and return type.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter type to the method, invalidating the cached signature if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeTypes
methods.description: Converts ambiguous type names to binary form for all parameters and return type, using an ApiList.
